steps.title: Harvest C. elegans
steps.instruction: Wash C. elegans from 3-5 plates containing a mixed population with gravid nematode adults using 3mL of M9.

steps.title: Initial Worm Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension at 800 x g for 2 minutes to pellet the worms while leaving bacteria in the supernatant. Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in M9.

steps.title: Prepare Bleaching Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a bleaching solution consisting of 3mL NaCIO, 1mL 5M NaOH, and 1mL H2O.

steps.title: Bleach Gravid Adults
steps.instruction: Add 4mL of freshly made bleaching solution to the worms and shake constantly for 3-5 minutes (do not exceed 5 minutes) to release eggs from the gravid C. elegans.

steps.title: Stop Bleaching Reaction
steps.instruction: Stop the reaction by adding 40 mL of M9 buffer.

steps.title: Initial Egg Recovery
steps.instruction: Quickly centrifuge the mixture at 1300xg for 3 minutes and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash Eggs
steps.instruction: Wash the eggs 2 more times using an equal amount of M9 buffer, centrifuging as in the previous step.

steps.title: Plate and Incubate Eggs
steps.instruction: Transfer the washed eggs onto NGM plates and incubate at 25 C°.

substeps.instruction: Allow eggs to develop to the L2 phase after 24 hours.
Supplement with OP50 E. coli to promote growth to the L4 phase.
